meta.title: Service PO: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that raising a Service PO is refused or unavailable.
Sign in as a Buyer in the same tenant and verify that raising a Service PO is available and succeeds.
Compare the non-Buyer and Buyer outcomes while accounting for tenant RBAC configuration.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that raising a Service PO is refused or unavailable.; Sign in as a Buyer in the same tenant and verify that raising a Service PO is available and succeeds.; Compare the non-Buyer and Buyer outcomes while accounting for tenant RBAC configuration.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user and then as the Buyer in the same tenant, attempt to raise a Service PO in both sessions, and report whether the non-Buyer action is refused or absent and the Buyer action is available or succeeds

steps.note: The catalog cannot access the Service PO flow or switch between users with different roles.
Confirm the session remains free of a crash or server error after the tester's role comparison.
